subtitle: BizHawk
_ap_world_name_source: confirmed word for word against the game list on archipelago.gg/games (2026-08-17); matched the tutorial URL
description: The Hoenn region as a multiworld. Badges, HM moves and key items are shuffled across the whole session, so progress through Hoenn depends on what the other players find.
_description_source: written by us from the structure of the game - no text copied from the game itself
_checks_verified_note: Stays false until the RAM map has been MEASURED in-game. Until then London warns at launch, so nobody sits in a multiworld wondering why no checks arrive.
_requires_source: GBA title - the game lives on a cartridge the player owns

rom._description_source: archipelago.gg setup guide, word for word
rom._hash_note: The guide states NO checksum for Emerald - unlike FireRed/LeafGreen, where SHA-1 for v1.0 and v1.1 is given. Stays empty until we can measure a dump and cross-check it against BizHawk's gamedb. Meanwhile the plugin falls back to a size check and says so plainly.

london_can_remove: the launcher finds the patch for the seed itself
the launcher knows the emulator path and starts EmuHawk with --lua=
the launcher owns the connection - the player types neither address nor port
_london_note: Twelve steps become two: point at your ROM, press Play.
